title: Criteria for Selecting Contractors for Post Office Counter Operations
full_text:
APPENDIX [Attached Table] — CRITERIA FOR SELECTING CONTRACTORS FOR POST OFFICE COUNTER OPERATIONS
(Related to Article 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act Concerning the Contracting Out of Post Office Counter Operations)
<Amended December 17, 2024>

The evaluation carries a total maximum score of 100 points. The criteria are divided into convenience of access (50 points) and ability to perform the operations (50 points).

I. CONVENIENCE OF ACCESS (50 POINTS)

A. Distance to a nearby post office (weight: 10 points)
The distance is measured as a straight line on a map. Separate assessment applies to special areas.

| Score | City area (Si) | Township or rural district (Eup/Myeon) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 3 km or more | 10 km or more |
| 8 | 2.5 km or more but less than 3 km | 8 km or more but less than 10 km |
| 6 | 2 km or more but less than 2.5 km | 6 km or more but less than 8 km |
| 4 | 1.5 km or more but less than 2 km | 4 km or more but less than 6 km |
| 2 | 1 km or more but less than 1.5 km | 2 km or more but less than 4 km |
| 1 | 0.5 km or more but less than 1 km | 1 km or more but less than 2 km |
| 0 | Less than 0.5 km | Less than 1 km |

B. Conditions around the proposed service location (weight: 10 points)

City area (Si):
- Mixed-use area combining office buildings, shops, and residential uses: 10 points.
- Commercial or shopping district: 8 points.
- Concentrated residential district with at least 5,000 households: 6 points.
- Within a complex of buildings: 4 points.
- Residential district: 2 points.

Township or rural district (Eup/Myeon):
- Location at the township or rural-district administrative center: 10 points.
- Residential district: 6 points.
- Other district: 2 points.

C. Transport conditions (weight: 10 points)
- Degree of adjacency to a road with at least two lanes carrying traffic in both directions: 2–4 points.
- Convenience of entry and exit, stopping, and parking for customers and mail-transport vehicles: 2–4 points.
- Ease of locating and identifying the proposed facility: 1–2 points.

D. Floor level of the proposed office (weight: 10 points)
- First floor above ground: 10 points.
- Second floor above ground: 7 points.
- First basement level: 4 points.
- Third floor above ground, if an elevator is installed: 1 point.
- Second basement level or below, and third floor above ground or higher where the specified elevator condition is not met: 0 points.

E. Ownership of the premises (weight: 5 points)
- Premises owned by the applicant: 5 points.
- Leased premises or premises owned by the applicant's family: 3 points.

F. Accessibility (weight: 5 points)
- Wheelchair access ramp installed for persons with reduced mobility: 5 points.
- Call bell installed for persons with reduced mobility: 3 points.
- No equipment or facility installed for access by persons with reduced mobility: 1 point.

II. CAPABILITY TO PERFORM THE OPERATIONS (50 POINTS)

A comprehensive assessment awarding up to 50 points, based on:
- Understanding of the postal business;
- Experience working in identical or similar public-service activities;
- Ability to provide services that satisfy customers;
- Willingness to cooperate in the development of postal business;
- Integrity, diligence, and the potential for development.

TOTAL POSSIBLE SCORE: 100 POINTS.

Note: If an applicant wishing to be entrusted with post office counter operations uses the building and facilities of a post office that has been closed, the applicant is considered to have met the requirements for the convenience-of-access category.
